cards.item_type: NO HOME IN THE TREE YET · Collabtunes business pitch pages
cards.summary: Typed documents and handwritten notes printed or written on white paper.
cards.typed_words:
[Left Page]
The 120 songs he wrote all the lyrics for and then asked singers and musicians
from all over the world to turn his words into songs proves it can be done. He's got the
lyrics to 250 more songs just waiting to be added to that collection!! But what if instead
of using YouTube as our platform - what if we took it to a physical location and yet still
let the online audience participate?
What if instead of bands coming to a venue to perform live finished songs - what
if they came to create new songs live on the spot?
Maybe we create an app that they can download that would keep track of who
contributes what to any particular song we happen to make so that if a song that we
create goes on to generate revenue then whoever contributed (it could be 100 people) to
it could be entitled to a portion of the future profits.
Basically, we use my big book of poems and current catalog of songs to attract talent
which attracts patrons. First we sell a dream of getting rich and famous. Then we sell
them stuff- food, drinks, merch, books, whatever... in the end, I am looking for a nice
sign on bonus, a weekly salary, a portion of all the proceeds and healthcare. :)
That's the main idea. I DON'T need to be well-known for this to work. I am better
behind the scenes. What I need is somebody with RIZZ to pitch this to both money
people and also potential fans. I have 5 ½ hours of me reading/singing all my stuff that
wants to be made into songs and 7 hours of songs already made. So I have a ton of lyrics
that we can do ANYTHING with. We would make a rock star or three with all my stuff
and skip the making live in person gig all together. I care about TWO THINGS:
me being able to pay my bills and live a life doing this and see where the world thinks that
I stack up with all the othe [...cut for the check]
